protocol: New fault-stratified system/service/fault group split: 100 train,25 validation,25 test; repetitions never cross partitions. Published V3 split unchanged. Recording midpoint+120s; frozen early baseline.
limitations: Same systems and service identities may occur across groups; no cross-system generalization claim.
RE1 lacks direct disk I/O, network delay and packet-loss measurements. Classifier predicts injected annotations from correlated signatures, never verifies a physical mechanism.
Known-incident fixed checkpoint, not end-to-end detection accuracy; V3 pre-injection false alarms remain.
Only 25 cases (five service/fault groups) in the new test set; repetitions are dependent.
